Isosurface raycasting — Met.3D 2.0.0 documentation
Isosurface raycasting Met.3D does not extract isosurfaces into triangle meshes. Instead, the volume raycaster actor renders them directly from the 3-D data texture in a fragment shader, so an isovalue can be changed without any geometry being rebuilt on the CPU. The same actor also implements direct volume rendering (DVR), which shares most of the machinery. Source code: src/actors ...
